summary_zh: DroidDeck 将 SteamOS 体验带到 Android，提供 Steam 游戏模式、完整 Linux 桌面、GOG、Epic Games、Xbox 等商店整合以及 Steam VR 等功能。项目开源，安装需下载 APK 和 Linux 运行时，并登录 Steam。
audience_zh: 适合想在 Android 设备上运行 Steam 游戏、使用 Linux 桌面或体验多商店整合的 Android 用户；需 Android 9 及以上、Adreno 730 或更新（或 8xx 系列）GPU，旧款 Adreno 6xx 仅实验性支持。

evidence.quote: DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to Android: Steam Gaming Mode, full Linux desktop, integration with GOG, Epic Games, Xbox, and other storefronts, Steam VR, and more!
1. Android 9 or newer on Adreno 730 or newer, or any 8xx. Adreno 6xx is experimental. Mali, Xclipse, PowerVR and Adreno 710 are unsupported. No root needed.
3. Install the [APK](https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck/releases/download/0.6.7/DroidDeck-0.6.7.apk), install the Linux runtime, press **Play** and sign in to Steam.
Compatibility and performance vary by device. Desktop compositing is software rendered, and Firefox sandboxing is reduced under proot.
